text:
Sasha: FYI customer Veridian asked us to onboard simian/simian-22b (HF v1.0) onto Dedicated (VPC + KMS). They want an nf4/int8 quant variant to cut cost while keeping chat Q&A quality. Target steady 8-12 RPS, p95 <200ms for short prompts, predictable mem. They shared ~10k sanitized prompts.

Kai: quick compatibility notes 1: model config mentions RMSNorm + rotary. Need to confirm rotary params (rope vs rotary) and tokenizer encoding. If tokenizer differs we must convert prompts. Also search repo for fused attention kernels (could affect quant).

Andrew: I'll own conversion + fp16 baseline. Bring-up checklist I propose:
- pull HF checkpoint & validate config
- convert to runtime artifact (GGUF/ONNX/PT)
- smoke run fp16 on 1 GPU for perf/quality
- run quant pipelines (nf4, per-channel int8 candidates)
- eval suite (small MMLU, extractive QA, customer samples)
- regression diffs vs fp16
ETA: smoke artifacts in ~48h.

Maria: I'll own evals. Plan: LM-eval-harness subset (MMLU small, PiQA), SQuAD-like QA, 100-instr chat checks, and sampled customer pool. Need a 2k sanitised calibration sample placed on S3. Pass criteria: QA F1 drop <=2% abs vs fp16 and instruction pass rate >=95% on manual checks.

Josh: quant gotchas: if repo uses fused flash-attn, numeric stability can change. Two strategies to try:
1) NF4 layerwise
2) Per-channel symmetric int8 on matmuls
Calibration: 2k-5k tokens, mix lengths. Example infra command:
```
./tools/quantize.py \
  --input simian-22b.pt \
  --output simian-22b.gguf \
  --mode nf4 \
  --calib-file s3://veridian/simian_calib.txt \
  --chunksize 512
```

Kai: I'll run tokenizer sanity + kernel scan and a single prompt logits check. Tokenizer quick check:
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('simian/simian-22b')
print(len(tok))
print(tok.eos_token)
```

Sasha: ops ask: customer wants a canary (10% traffic) pre-rollout. Ops team please prepare a canary route and fallback to fp16. Also add a metric tracking embedding cosine diff between fp16 and quant on sampled requests.

quant-ci-bot: kicked off a small containerized conversion test, will post smoke logs in ~1h.

Andrew: perf notes: rough baseline on A100 fp16 ~600 tok/s single-stream for 22B with optimized kernels; nf4 might be ~1.5-1.8x throughput. Will measure exact numbers during baseline.

Maria: I'll compute embedding drift and include in eval report.

Josh: capture peak memory for 2048 context + kv-cache per token. If OOM risk, consider sharded serving or limit context for Dedicated SKU.

Sasha: owners: Andrew (conversion + fp16), Josh (quant experiments), Maria (evals), Kai (compat). Smoke update by EOD tomorrow, full evaluation & canary plan in 5 business days. I'll move the intake to a bring-up project in Asana. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
